# LipDub MCP server

> An MCP server that lets an AI agent lip-sync a video to a different audio track using
> LipDub 2. You supply a source video of a person speaking and the audio you want them
> to appear to say; LipDub returns a video where the lip movement matches the new audio.

Important: LipDub 2 does **not** translate, transcribe, or generate speech. The caller
supplies finished audio. To dub into another language, generate that audio with a
text-to-speech or voice tool first, host it at a public URL, and pass that URL.

Both inputs are public URLs, not local file paths. A render takes about 7–15 minutes
and consumes credits from the user's LipDub account. Checking status is free and is not
rate-limited.

## Tools

- `lipdub_check_connection` — verify the API key and identify the account. Free.
- `lipdub_create_render` — start a render from `video_url` + `audio_url`. **Spends credits.**
- `lipdub_get_render` — status, plus the download link once the render is finished. Free.
- `lipdub_wait_for_render` — block for a bounded window rather than polling. Free.
- `lipdub_list_renders` — recent renders, to recover a lost render id. Free.

- [README](https://github.com/marzvfx/lipdub-mcp/blob/main/README.md): install snippets for Claude, Cursor, VS Code, Gemini CLI and Codex; file hosting recipes; troubleshooting.

- [LipDub API reference](https://lipdub.readme.io/): the underlying REST API.
- [LipDub API docs index](https://lipdub.readme.io/llms.txt): machine-readable index of the API documentation.
